notes.title: V131
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where units would step too far into impassable territory
 Adjustments to missions 2, 5 and 7

notes.title: V130.2
notes.content:
Added new buttons next to the minimap!

 Focus King
 Select All Army (F2)
 Select All Spawners (F3)
 Open Menu (F10)
The buttons for F2/F3 also show the respective amount of available units.

Further improvements

 Updated to SDL3
 Should more reliably catch certain GPU errors
 Can now change mouse confinement setting while the game is running

notes.title: V130 - CLOUDY
notes.content:
Fixed a visibility calculation bug
 Hostile units no longer cast fog of war behind them
 Air units can once again not look inside Clouds
 Added Coven to Missions 1 and 2

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
Fix two panics:

 "argument of integer logarithm must be positive"
 "Uniform::new called with `low >= high`"


Also fix issues in missions 3 and 10.

notes.title: V129
notes.content:
Some fixes and improvements to missions
 Fix Jugglernaut not hitting certain enemies well
 Leaderboards are now cross-patch
 Leaderboard submissions should more quickly show up in the displayed ranking

notes.title: V128.1
notes.content:
Warnings/pings are now played also when player-controlled buildings or artifacts are under attack

Current leaderboards nick is now loaded on start up

UI gives proper feedback for changing the nick

Added explanation text for Conquest and Invasion modes to menu

A few improvements to visuals and descriptions in-game

notes.title: Demo Updated for Next Fest + Co-Op
notes.content:
The Demo has received a big update for June’s (current!) Next Fest!


Experience 5 STORY-RICH campaign missions. Coming in two flavours: FAST and STRATEGIC

Endure against ever-growing enemy forces in Invasion mode

Steamroll the unassuming universe in Conquest mode

Compete head-to-head in multiplayer

… or cooperate : Both Invasion and Conquest are freshly available in online co-op as well
Enjoy!
